author: bfej
quote:
They spent 13 years developing this game, and somehow the story is one of the worst ones I've played in my entire life. You're telling me I have to prioritize my relationship, avoid building up a criminal record, and basically play against what Grand Theft Auto has always been about if I want the "good endings"? I thought this was Grand Theft Auto. Why am I being punished for actually playing like a criminal in a game about being a criminal? The whole point of GTA has always been freedom to do whatever the hell you want, and yet it feels like the game constantly wants to dictate how you should play and what kind of person you should be.

The story is painfully slow at times, missions feel unnecessarily restrictive, and there are moments where it feels like I'm spending more time watching cutscenes or doing pointless activities than actually playing the game.After 13 years of waiting, I expected something that would blow me away. Instead, I got a story that constantly prioritizes a relationship over the criminal chaos that made this franchise what it is in the first place. The world itself might be incredible, but a beautiful map doesn't make up for a disappointing story. This is GTA, not a relationship simulator.

1/10, only for the graphics.
